component.name: Libreri
component.summary: Read, take notes and remember: your library on your own computer

description.p: Libreri keeps your books, papers, comics, audiobooks and podcasts in one library: an ordinary folder you own, with your notes and highlights beside it as readable files. Nothing leaves your computer unless you ask.

ul.li: Read PDF, EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, DjVu, Markdown, RTF and comics, with tabs, page themes and full screen
Highlights, comments with maths, a notebook per book, handwriting canvases and voice notes
Daily review: flashcards from your own highlights on a spaced schedule, with export to Anki
A reading calendar with goals and streaks, and a study timer
Read aloud with natural voices made on your computer, audiobooks linked to their books, and podcasts
Feeds for arXiv, journals and newsletters, added to your library with their details
Full-text search, text recognition for scans, PDF page editing and safe redaction
Profiles with PINs, Kids profiles, and exports to BibTeX, Obsidian, Calibre and more
